title: pteris khasiana
intro: Pteris khasiana, commonly known as the Himalayan Brake fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Pteris khasiana include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to have anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-oxidative therapeutic actions.
